title: DB_DSN environment variable used in code but still not documented
evidence: main.go line 38 reads DB_DSN with default 'postgres://localhost:5432/orders?sslmode=disable'. docs/requirements.md FR-34 lists PORT and LOG_LEVEL but does not mention DB_DSN.
description: FR-34 requires all configuration to be read from environment variables with documented defaults. DB_DSN is read in code (main.go:38) but absent from the requirements documentation. The gap was present before remediation and was not in scope for the approved remediation plan.
recommended_action: Add DB_DSN to docs/requirements.md section 3 (Configuration) specifying default value postgres://localhost:5432/orders?sslmode=disable and its purpose

title: D-04: Final Dockerfile stage uses debian:bookworm-slim instead of distroless/scratch
evidence: D-04 requires 'scratch or a distroless image'. Dockerfile line 19: FROM debian:bookworm-slim
description: Docker Gate D-04 recommends a minimal final stage image. The Dockerfile uses debian:bookworm-slim, which is not distroless or scratch. This was a medium finding before remediation and remains unaddressed, consistent with the approved scope (medium/low findings were not in scope).
recommended_action: Change the final stage to gcr.io/distroless/base-debian12:nonroot or gcr.io/distroless/static:nonroot
